{{Quote|Now now. I know what you're thinking. But don't let my good looks intimidate you. Besides, I'm nothing like the other Hutts you may have heard of. But I'm exactly like those you've never heard of.|Vranki the Blue|<ref name="The Voxx Vortex 5000" />}}
'''Vranki''', known as '''Vranki the Blue''', was a [[Hutt]] who ran a [[Vranki's Hotel and Casino|hotel and casino]].<ref name="The Voxx Vortex 5000" /> As proprietor, host, and promoter of Vranki's Hotel and Casino, Vranki the Blue's corpulent form glided around his resort, overseeing his massive empire of [[gambling]] and [[Racing (disambiguation)|racing]]. Although he prided himself in being different than other Hutts, Vranki wasn't above cheating to ensure the odds were  in his favor, especially when a substantial prize was on the line.<ref name="The Voxx Vortex 5000" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Vranki first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'' episode "[[The Voxx Vortex 5000]]," voiced by [[John DiMaggio]].<ref name="The Voxx Vortex 5000" /> Vranki's original name in the outline of the episode was "Janki", but was later changed. According to art director [[Amy Beth Christenson]], Vranki was originally supposed to wear a [[hat]], but it was changed during the design phase to a [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]]-like [[cape]]. To differentiate him from the other Hutts, Vranki was given a more friendly face and an up-turned nose.<ref name="Unused Name and Clothing & Friendly Personality">{{SW|url=news/buckets-list-extra-the-voxx-vortex-5000-star-wars-resistance|text=Bucket's List Extra: 7 Fun Facts from "The Voxx Vortex 5000" - ''Star Wars Resistance''}}</ref>
